acoes.vouAjuda: Tap again to undo. Nobody sees who confirmed.
acoes.chegarAjuda: Opens the free map (OpenStreetMap) at the action's meeting point, outside Alumia. Alumia never asks for or stores your location.
acoes.copiado: Link copied. Paste it wherever you want to call people.
acoes.agendaAjuda: The file is created on this device; the reminder stays with your calendar.
acoes.apoioAjuda: Opens outside Alumia. No payment goes through here.
acoes.erroVou: Couldn't confirm right now. Try again.
acoes.entrarParaIr: Sign in to Alumia to confirm
acoes.chegarExplica: The map opens outside Alumia, with only the action's public meeting point. Nobody learns that you opened it.
acoes.lembreteAjuda: Downloads an .ics file: your calendar reminds you 24 h and 2 h before. Nothing goes to the server.
acoes.baixado: Calendar file downloaded. Open it to save the reminder.
acoes.vouFeito: Confirmed. You are in the mosaic.
acoes.vouDesfeitoLeitor: Confirmation undone. You have {s} seconds to undo.
acoes.vouRefeito: Confirmation restored. You are in the mosaic.

mosaico.voce: You're in the mosaic: the golden card.
mosaico.explica: Each lit card is someone who confirmed; the more people, the sharper the word.
mosaico.poucas: The mosaic lights up from 3 confirmations. Until then, no number is shown.
mosaico.voceConfirmou: You confirmed. The mosaic lights up once 3 people confirm.
mosaico.rotuloApagado: Mosaic of the action {palavra}: still dark
mosaico.cancelado: Action cancelled: the mosaic stays dark.
mosaico.atraso: The mosaic updates every 15 minutes, so nobody can tell who just confirmed.

tela.vazioSeguindo: Nobody you follow has called an action yet.
tela.cidadeAjuda: "Nearby" uses the city you type. Alumia never uses your device's location, and the city stays only on this device.
tela.puxar: release to go to the next action
tela.atalhos: Shortcuts: J goes to the next action and K back to the previous one.
tela.cidadeCurta: Type the name of the city (at least 2 letters).

pagina.naoAchado: This action doesn't exist or you can't see it.
pagina.total: {n} people confirmed. Only you see this number.
pagina.totalPoucas: Fewer than 3 people confirmed. Only you see this.
pagina.motivoExemplo: e.g.: cancelled due to rain · new date soon
pagina.aviso: Everyone who confirmed gets a notice. Nobody is caught by surprise.
pagina.erroMudar: Couldn't change the action. Try again.
pagina.dataRuim: Pick a future date, up to one year ahead.
pagina.semMeta: No goal (the mosaic counts up to 30)

perto.semCidade: Type your city in Actions to see what's nearby. No GPS.

formulario.chamadoExemplo: Why go, what time to arrive and what to bring.
formulario.previa: The mosaic starts dark and lights up with each person who confirms.

problemas.palavra: Use letters: the name becomes the mosaic word.
problemas.link: Use an https:// link with no phone or ID number.

formulario.metaAjuda: How many people you want to gather. The mosaic lights up relative to it (at least 30).
formulario.linkAjuda: https:// only. No payments here: the link opens outside Alumia.

erros.ato_cancelado: This action was cancelled: you can no longer confirm.
erros.ato_passou: This action already happened: you can no longer confirm.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests in a row. Wait a little and try again.
erros.consentimento: To do this, first accept the Alumia rules.
erros.entre_primeiro: Sign in to Alumia to do this.
erros.nao_encontrado: This action no longer exists or you can't see it.
erros.so_quem_organizou: Only whoever called the action can change this.
erros.so_coordenacao: Only the action's coordination can change the beacon.
erros.so_org_verificada: Only a verified organization can open a chain.
erros.corrente_fechada: This chain has already closed: the goal was reached.
erros.dado_pessoal: Remove the personal data (phone, e-mail, ID) from the text.
erros.data: Pick a future date within the allowed range.
erros.texto: Check the text: it is too short, too long or missing.
erros.sem_rede: No connection right now. Check your internet and try again.
erros.tarefa_completa: Someone is already bringing this. Pick another task.
erros.peticao_encerrada: This petition is closed: it no longer takes signatures.
erros.peticao_existe: This action already has a petition.
erros.palavra: The name needs letters: it becomes the mosaic word.
erros.titulo: Check the action name: 2 to 60 characters.
erros.onde: Check the meeting point: 3 to 140 characters.
erros.link_apoio: The support link must start with https:// and cannot contain a phone or ID number.
erros.meta: Check the number: it is out of range.
erros.limite_do_quadro: This board has reached its limit.

explica.atencao: Stay close to your group and watch for updates.
explica.dispersar: Leave calmly, in groups, by the agreed route.

farol.coordenarAjuda: It only takes effect when two people from the coordination request the same state within 15 minutes. Those who confirmed get a notice with no text.
farol.novoPontoExemplo: e.g. Silva Teles Square, in front of the school
farol.erroPonto: Write the new meeting point with at least 3 characters.
farol.esperando: You requested {estado}. A second person from the coordination still has to confirm (until {hora}).
farol.trocarPedido: You already requested {pendente}. Tap again to switch to {estado}.

corrente.poucos: Links show up from 3 replies on.
corrente.fechada: Chain closed: the goal was reached!
corrente.total: {n} replied. Only the organization sees this number.
corrente.abrirAjuda: For an urgent call for people (eviction, picket, work party). Shown to whoever looks at actions in the written city. Up to 2 a week.
corrente.textoExemplo: We need 30 people at 5 am at the Esperança occupation
corrente.barraVazia: Chain: the links are still open
corrente.fechouAgora: The chain is closed! Thank you for being part of it.
corrente.erroTexto: Write the request with at least 10 characters (up to 140).
corrente.erroMeta: The goal goes from 3 to 5,000 people.
corrente.erroHora: The time must be in the future.

tarefas.explica: Each person picks what to bring. Only the organizers see who took each task.
tarefas.vazio: No tasks for this action yet.
tarefas.vazioOrg: Add what the action needs: sound system, banners, water, first aid.
tarefas.quem: Who took it (only you see this): {nomes}
tarefas.entrar: Sign in to Alumia to take a task.

caronas.explica: Only the departure point is shown. No phone or address: contact happens only in private chat.
caronas.vazioOfertas: Nobody has offered a ride yet.
caronas.vazioPedidos: Nobody has asked for a ride yet.
caronas.saidaAjuda: A public place. Never your home address or phone.
caronas.combinarAjuda: Opens a private, encrypted conversation with whoever posted it. Nobody else sees it.
caronas.combinarEmBreve: Ride chat is coming soon. Until then, arrange it in the action's conversation without sharing contact details.
caronas.entrar: Sign in to Alumia to see and offer rides.
caronas.limite: You already have 2 rides for this action.
caronas.dado: Remove the phone, email or house number: contact happens only in chat.

peticao.explica: Nobody sees who signed, not even whoever created it. Only the total shows, from 3 on, updated every 15 minutes.
peticao.criarAjuda: A petition tied to this action. It never goes out to the Fediverse.
peticao.assinado: Signature recorded. Nobody sees your name.
peticao.entrar: Sign in to Alumia to sign.
